Ability.Name: -- Motor por nombres --
Ability.Lua:
-- Motor por NOMBRE localizado (cliente esES). No usa IDs de hechizos. if not HN then HN = {}
function HN.RefreshBook() HN.Book = {} if not GetSpellName then return end for i = 1, 300 do local name = GetSpellName(i, BOOKTYPE_SPELL) if not name then break end HN.Book[name] = true end end
function HN.Known(spellName) if not spellName or not GetSpellName then return false end if not HN.Book then HN.RefreshBook() end return HN.Book[spellName] == true end
if not HN.BookEventFrame then HN.BookEventFrame = CreateFrame("Frame") HN.BookEventFrame:RegisterEvent("SPELLS_CHANGED") HN.BookEventFrame:SetScript("OnEvent", function() HN.RefreshBook() end) end
function HN.Buff(unit, spellName) if not UnitExists(unit) then return false end for i = 1, 40 do local name = UnitBuff(unit, i) if not name then break end if name == spellName then return true end end return false end
function HN.Debuff(unit, spellName) if not UnitExists(unit) then return false end for i = 1, 40 do local name = UnitDebuff(unit, i) if not name then break end if name == spellName then return true end end return false end
function HN.GCD() local probes = {"Disparo firme", "Disparo Arcano", "Marca del cazador", "Picadura de serpiente"} for _, name in ipairs(probes) do if HN.Known(name) then local start, duration = GetSpellCooldown(name) if start and duration and duration > 0 and duration <= 1.6 and start + duration > GetTime() then return true end end end return false end
function HN.Ready(spellName) if StopRota then return false end if not HN.Known(spellName) then return false end if UnitCastingInfo("player") or UnitChannelInfo("player") then return false end if not IsUsableSpell(spellName) then return false end local start, duration = GetSpellCooldown(spellName) if start and duration and duration > 1.6 and start + duration > GetTime() then return false end if HN.GCD() then return false end return true end
function HN.Cast(spellName, unit) if not HN.Ready(spellName) then return false end if unit and UnitExists(unit) and IsSpellInRange(spellName, unit) == 0 then return false end -- PQR ejecuta este Lua con su motor de desbloqueo; SpellID=0 evita el casteo por ID. CastSpellByName(spellName) return true end
function HN.TargetOK() return not StopRota and UnitExists("target") and UnitCanAttack("player", "target") and not UnitIsDeadOrGhost("target") end
function HN.HP(unit) if not UnitExists(unit) or UnitHealthMax(unit) == 0 then return 100 end return 100 * UnitHealth(unit) / UnitHealthMax(unit) end
function HN.Mana() if UnitPowerMax("player") == 0 then return 100 end return 100 * UnitPower("player") / UnitPowerMax("player") end end return false

Ability.Name: -- Control de rotacion --
Ability.Lua: if not HN then return false end if IsLeftControlKeyDown() and not HN.ctrl then HN.ctrl = true StopRota = not StopRota PQR_WriteToChat(StopRota and "Rotacion pausada" or "Rotacion activa") elseif not IsLeftControlKeyDown() then HN.ctrl = false end if IsRightAltKeyDown() and not HN.alt then HN.alt = true HN.aoe = not HN.aoe PQR_WriteToChat(HN.aoe and "Modo de area ACTIVADO" or "Modo de area DESACTIVADO") elseif not IsRightAltKeyDown() then HN.alt = false end return false

Ability.Name: -- Mantener mascota --
Ability.Lua: if StopRota or IsMounted() then return false end if not UnitExists("pet") then return HN.Cast("Llamar a mascota") end if UnitIsDead("pet") then return HN.Cast("Revivir mascota") end if HN.HP("pet") < 68 and HN.Known("Aliviar mascota") and not HN.Buff("pet", "Aliviar mascota") then TargetUnit("pet") local casted = HN.Cast("Aliviar mascota") TargetLastTarget() return casted end return false

Ability.Name: -- Ataque de mascota --
Ability.Lua: if HN.TargetOK() and UnitExists("pet") and not UnitIsDead("pet") then if UnitExists("pettarget") == nil or UnitGUID("pettarget") ~= UnitGUID("target") then PetAttack() return true end end return false

Ability.Name: -- Aspecto ofensivo --
Ability.Lua: if StopRota then return false end if HN.Mana() < 22 and HN.Known("Aspecto de la víbora") then if not HN.Buff("player", "Aspecto de la víbora") then return HN.Cast("Aspecto de la víbora") end else if HN.Known("Aspecto del dracohalcón") then if not HN.Buff("player", "Aspecto del dracohalcón") then return HN.Cast("Aspecto del dracohalcón") end elseif HN.Known("Aspecto del halcón") and not HN.Buff("player", "Aspecto del halcón") then return HN.Cast("Aspecto del halcón") end end return false
